summary.text: Vernon Smith is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 14 since 1990 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously worked as an educator, including as a principal in Gary Community Schools and an assistant professor at Indiana University Northwest.

paragraphs.text: Smith earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University in 1966, a graduate degree in 1969 and a law degree in 1978, all from Indiana University.
His professional experience includes working as an assistant professor of education at Indiana University Northwest, principal of Gary Community Schools, and teacher.
Smith took office in the Indiana House in 1990 and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
